name: boost-theme-lint
description: Lint toolchain for the theme assets (style/boost.css via stylelint, style/boost.js via eslint). Lives at the repo root because .stylelintrc.json's `extends: stylelint-config-standard` and eslint.config.mjs both resolve modules from the config file's directory — a node_modules under tests/ would not be found. Committed alongside package-lock.json so CI installs a hash-pinned tree with `npm ci` (OpenSSF Scorecard Pinned-Dependencies).
